messages.content:
You write realistic support tickets that clinic staff send to the support team of a fictional practice-management product. It has no brand name: never name it, and never name a real company, product or person. Write one ticket per brief. A ticket is a single email-style message with a subject and a body, in the requester's own voice, about the brief's topic, matching its situation, tone and level of detail:
- brief: one or two sentences
- moderate: three to five sentences
- detailed: a short paragraph or two with specifics, such as what they clicked, what they saw and what they already tried
Describe the problem the way a busy clinic employee would, not in the topic's words. Never mention the brief, topics, areas or situations. Never include a patient's real details: say 'a patient' or use made-up initials.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: ticket_texts.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"WrittenTicket": {"properties": {"body": {"minLength": 10, "title": "Body", "type": "string"}, "id": {"title": "Id", "type": "string"}, "subject": {"minLength": 3, "title": "Subject", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["id", "subject", "body"], "title": "WrittenTicket", "type": "object"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"tickets": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/WrittenTicket"}, "title": "Tickets", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["tickets"], "title": "ticket_texts", "type": "object"}

value.text: {"tickets": [{"body": "Hi there, I'm really scratching my head over the questionnaire builder we use for pre-visit forms. I tried putting together a new health history questionnaire for our patients to fill out online before coming in, but every time I hit the publish button, it throws up some strange validation error on the phone number field that I just can't figure out. I've tried deleting the field and adding it back, changing the formatting requirements, and even retyping the whole question text, but it keeps giving me the same red warning triangle without explaining what's actually wrong with it. Could someone please take a look at our setup and tell me what field property I'm messing up so we can get this questionnaire live for next week's appointments?", "id": "gen-291", "subject": "Confused about form validation error when publishing intake questionnaire"}, {"body": "Good morning, we are writing to request guidance regarding the proper workflow for handling pharmacy notifications when a prescribed medication is out of stock. Please provide instructions on how our providers should submit alternative therapeutic agent substitutions through the system.", "id": "gen-292", "subject": "Inquiry regarding medication out-of-stock substitution workflows"}, {"body": "Dear Support Team, we are writing to request standard configuration instructions for adjusting the automated delay timers on diagnostic test results and lab reports prior to patient portal visibility. Please advise on the administrative path required to modify these release rules.", "id": "gen-293", "subject": "Request for documentation on test result portal release delay configuration"}, {"body": "Hello, I am working on posting our latest batch of insurance remittances and paper checks from this week's mail. Could you please provide guidance on how to properly allocate a payment that was accidentally split across multiple invoice lines so the ledger balances correctly?", "id": "gen-294", "subject": "Question on applying insurance remittances across multiple lines"}, {"body": "Hello, apologies for reaching out with this quick question, but our providers would like to know the correct procedure for managing pharmacy alerts regarding out-of-stock medications and executing therapeutic substitutions in the system. Thank you for your time.", "id": "gen-295", "subject": "Assistance needed for medication out-of-stock and substitution alerts"}, {"body": "I am terribly sorry to bother you while patients are actively waiting in our exam rooms, but our lab alert parameters seem to have reverted and we are missing critical notifications. Could you please help us immediately adjust the threshold parameters for our abnormal lab flags so we don't miss any urgent values today? Thank you so much for your prompt attention.", "id": "gen-296", "subject": "URGENT: Critical lab value notification thresholds need adjustment immediately"}, {"body": "Hello, I need to know how we are supposed to direct clinical messages coming from the patient portal to the right staff members because the current routing is a complete mess. Please advise.", "id": "gen-297", "subject": "Patient portal secure message routing assistance"}, {"body": "Greetings, we are writing to inquire about the administrative settings used to configure automated notification rules for critical laboratory values. Could you please provide documentation or steps on how our practice can adjust the threshold parameters that trigger abnormal flags for our clinical team?", "id": "gen-298", "subject": "Configuration of critical lab value notification rules and thresholds"}, {"body": "Hi, I don't know if your servers are having a major glitch right now, but none of us can attach outside scanned PDF lab reports to patient charts. Every time I try to drop a file in, the whole screen freezes up completely.", "id": "gen-299", "subject": "System freezing when trying to upload scanned paper lab reports"}, {"body": "Good grief, I am at my wits' end trying to deal with the patient portal accounts today. Patients constantly call my desk because they are locked out or cannot remember their passwords, and the tool to reset or unlock their access is buried under three different menus. I tried walking an elderly patient through the password recovery link this morning, but the verification email never arrived in their inbox even after I clicked resend three times, which completely stalled our check-in flow. Can you please explain why these reset links are failing and how I am actually supposed to clear out these locked portal accounts quickly without wasting twenty minutes per person?", "id": "gen-300", "subject": "Frustrated with patient portal password reset and account unlocking issues"}]}
